days.reason: The yard is calm this morning and nobody is in a hurry. The day ends when the last ship flies away.
Word got around overnight and ships are queuing up outside. The clock is the real enemy, so pick the easy ones first.
It is a quiet day because a fixed batch of hulls is booked in from the outer lanes. The day ends when the last one flies away.
Half the sector is limping toward the station and the docks are filling fast. Time is short today, so do not chase the hard ones first.
Quiet lanes, and the wrecks that come in are the kind you know well. The day ends when the last ship flies away.
The convoys are back and every bay will fill before the clock runs out. Time is the limit, so keep the bays moving.
Last push of the run, and the whole sector seems to be heading our way. Time is the only thing that matters, so make every release count.
